plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the physicist Edward Teller was friendly with Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor of unusual electrical propulsion devices, and was shown a demonstration of one of Brown's experiments. According to Michels, Teller said he had no idea how it worked and was alarmed, and a wealthy investor named Floyd Odlum put money into Brown's work. The story is told to suggest Brown had found something that even top scientists could not explain.
